description: Calculates what manual, repetitive work caused by disconnected systems costs per year: staff hours, full-time equivalents, labor and error costs, five-year cost, and the savings from automating it. Input a list of tasks with hours per week; hourly cost is optional.

automation_rate.description: Share of these hours that connecting the systems would remove, 0–1 (default 0.7).

default_hourly_cost_usd.description: Hourly cost used when a task has none (default $40).

tasks.description: Each manual or repetitive task caused by disconnected systems.

error_cost_per_month_usd.description: Optional: estimated monthly cost of mistakes this task causes (wrong orders, billing errors, rework).

hourly_cost_usd.description: Fully loaded hourly cost of the people doing it (wage plus benefits and taxes). Defaults to default_hourly_cost_usd.

hours_per_week.description: Total staff hours per week spent on this task, across everyone who does it.

task.description: The manual task, e.g. 'Re-typing web orders into QuickBooks', 'Building the monthly sales report'.

name: calculate_manual_work_cost
title: Manual Work Cost Calculator
